title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 6, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: OpenHands/OpenHands is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: OpenHands/OpenHands leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: OpenHands/OpenHands — 26 commits today, 16.3 above its current daily pace, with 30 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
NousResearch/hermes-agent — 89 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
earendil-works/pi — No same-day commit after 162 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Watch Pi's new remote execution package at the SSH boundary
dailyInsight.insight: Pi now has a source-defined execution environment that can run agent tools on another machine while the Durable worker and its storage remain on the controller.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The October 5 pi-env addition implements Durable's ExecutionEnv through a remote daemon. Its SSH bootstrap selects and deploys the matching binary; the client maps filesystem and command results back to the local interface.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Builders can investigate separating the machine holding agent state and model access from the machine doing file and command work, without inventing every remote tool interface themselves.

actions.audience: Builders embedding Pi Durable with remote workspaces
actions.label: Watch a reproducible remote task
actions.instruction: Follow a pinned package demonstration that reads, edits and runs a disposable task over SSH, then interrupts the connection. Check where state remains and how unknown mutation outcomes are reported before adopting the interface.

receipts.title: Remote execution environment and daemon
receipts.supports: Introduces the remote ExecutionEnv, Rust daemon and conformance/differential test definitions.

receipts.title: Pi-env package contract at v1.0.4
receipts.supports: Describes worker/tool separation, SSH bootstrap and packaged platform binaries; this is a pinned source contract.

receipts.title: Connection behavior at v1.0.4
receipts.supports: The connection restarts after loss, while in-flight requests fail and mutation outcomes can be unknown.

confidence.basis: Implementation, SSH settings and upstream test definitions were inspected at the containing tag; no independent SSH integration was executed.

dailyInsight.limitation: This is an SDK capability, not evidence that the ordinary Pi terminal agent automatically runs remotely. Package installation, remote task execution and platform equivalence were not independently tested. SSH is not a sandbox, and reconnection does not resolve unknown in-flight mutations.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A pinned package lacking the documented daemon, or a reproducible task showing incompatible tool semantics across the SSH boundary, would narrow the capability claim.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A released-package task trace with disconnect handling and an explicit account of controller state, remote authority and completed mutations.
